fields.label: Visit Type
fields.description: Customer = check-in at an existing customer. Lead = check-in at a prospect from the Leads tab. Exactly one of Customer / Lead must be filled, matching this value.

fields.label: Visited
fields.description: Customer name or lead name, filled automatically on save.

fields.label: Target Coordinates (Measured Against)
fields.description: The customer/lead pin (lat,lng) the distance was measured against. Empty = the target had no coordinates, so the visit is Off-Site.

fields.label: On-Site
fields.description: Set automatically: ticked only when Target Coordinates exist AND Distance From Target is 100 m or less. Every report counts this field.

fields.label: Original Distance From Target (Meters)
fields.description: Distance computed at check-in against the target's coordinates at that moment. Never changed by a location correction.

fields.label: Location Corrected
fields.description: Set automatically when the target's location was corrected during this visit and Distance From Target was recomputed.

fields.label: Location Correction Source
fields.description: GPS Snap = target bound to the rep's own position (corrected distance is ~0 by construction). Maps Link = independent Google Maps pin.

fields.label: Lead Status After
fields.description: The status actually stored on the Lead when the rep saved and checked out.

fields.label: Lead Visit Notes
fields.description: Notes captured during this lead visit. The Lead's own Notes table is not used.

fields.label: Closed By Conversion
fields.description: Set automatically when the office converted this lead to a customer while the visit was still open, closing the visit.

fields.label: Visit Outcome
fields.options:
Order Placed
No Order - Interested
No Order - Not Interested
Customer Unavailable
Follow-Up Required
Stock/Delivery Complaint

fields.label: Visit With Report
fields.description: Automatically set when a visit report is submitted for this check-in. Never editable directly.

fields.label: Collections Report
fields.description: Composed on submission as: 'Outstanding = X & Overdue = Y : <rep's note>'

fields.label: Is Collections Report
fields.description: Automatically set when the rep files a report through the 'Send Report on Current Collections' flow. Lets future reporting/filtering pull just the collections-flavored visit reports without parsing collections_report's text.
